components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is stored and used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and this field is returned as the composed address (the
            normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the normalized addressLine2
            when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Optional and
            preferred over the flat 'address' when present (non-blank). An owner is
            valid when it supplies an address in EITHER form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'), plus city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address
            (e.g. apartment or unit). When present it is normalized and appended to
            the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode (4 digits). Optional. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. When not supplied on
            creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied on
            creation it is stored and used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Returned
            in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already shares its household (same last name and postcode). This only
            bypasses the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only;
            used only when creating an owner.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a space and
                the last name when a title was supplied (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the
                last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the
                country code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region derived from the owner's postcode and HASH8 is the
                first 8 upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of
                the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted
                '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the two-digit fiscal year (starting
                1 July) of the registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-1A2B3C4D-M27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the
                same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode
                ('<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'). Owners with the same last name and
                postcode share this identifier automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, the lower-case hex SHA-256
                of '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Duplicate
                detection is consolidated onto this single key - a create is rejected
                with 409 only when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '3b8f...c1a2 (64 lower-case hex characters)'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner
                was created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created today (on the same registration date);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when, at the time this owner was created, the owner's
                city already held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive), approaching the
                hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned on creation. Starts
                at 0; gains 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3
                when the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (starting
                1 July) since the registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints; 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6
                or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the
                two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the
                '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code assigned on creation, or 'UNKNOWN' when
                no customer code has been assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from the supplied birthDate as
                at the registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a
                hard duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                with a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates
                (shared last name and postcode with a different telephone). Present only
                when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created
                owner is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} sets it true while retaining
                the record. Soft-deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:

components:

          type: string
          format: uri

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string

          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time

          title: Schema validation errors

      required:

        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:

    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is stored and used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and this field is returned as the composed address (the
            normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the normalized addressLine2
            when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Optional and
            preferred over the flat 'address' when present (non-blank). An owner is
            valid when it supplies an address in EITHER form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'), plus city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address
            (e.g. apartment or unit). When present it is normalized and appended to
            the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode (4 digits). Optional. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. When not supplied on
            creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied on
            creation it is stored and used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Returned
            in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already shares its household (same last name and postcode). This only
            bypasses the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only;
            used only when creating an owner.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:

      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a space and
                the last name when a title was supplied (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the
                last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the
                country code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region derived from the owner's
                postcode (falling back to the city, then 'UNKNOWN'); FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the
                same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode
                ('<normalizedLastName>|<postcode>'). Owners with the same last name and
                postcode share this identifier automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, the lower-case hex SHA-256
                of '<normalizedTelephone>|<lowerEmail>|<soundex(lastName)>'. Duplicate
                detection is consolidated onto this single key - a create is rejected
                with 409 only when a new owner's whole identity key equals an existing
                owner's.
              type: string
              example: '3b8f...c1a2 (64 lower-case hex characters)'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner
                was created, already shared the same first name and last name
                (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when, at the time this owner was created, more than 80
                owners had already been created today (on the same registration date);
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when, at the time this owner was created, the owner's
                city already held between 40 and 49 owners (inclusive), approaching the
                hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, assigned on creation. Starts
                at 0; gains 2 when an email address is present, 1 when the owner has no
                namesakes (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3
                when the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (starting
                1 July) since the registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, derived from
                membershipPoints; 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6
                or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the
                two-digit fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, taken from the REGION segment of the
                '<REGION>-<HASH8>' customer code assigned on creation, or 'UNKNOWN' when
                no customer code has been assigned.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone, derived from the locality/region
                via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the
                region is not one of these.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from the supplied birthDate as
                at the registrationDate; 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18-64, and
                'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Present only when a birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD),
                otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL',
                'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a
                hard duplicate but shared an existing owner's last name and postcode
                with a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates

                when 'possibleDuplicate' is true.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created

                the record. Soft-deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's optional honorific title (e.g. MR, MRS, MS, DR).
            When supplied it is stored and used to compose the owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred and this field is returned as the composed address (the
            normalized addressLine1, plus a space and the normalized addressLine2
            when addressLine2 is present).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Optional and
            preferred over the flat 'address' when present (non-blank). An owner is
            valid when it supplies an address in EITHER form (a non-blank
            'addressLine1', or the flat 'address'), plus city.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address
            (e.g. apartment or unit). When present it is normalized and appended to
            the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '.*\S.*'
          example: '6085551023'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's postcode (4 digits). Optional. When present it must
            be valid for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any
            4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. When not supplied on
            creation it defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO
            'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When supplied on
            creation it is stored and used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'. Returned
            in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even though another owner
            already shares its household (same last name and postcode). This only
            bypasses the household-duplicate block; the owner is created as a declared
            household member and is not flagged as a possible duplicate. Write-only;
            used only when creating an owner.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical API path of this owner, formatted
                '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, composed as the title, a space and
                the last name when a title was supplied (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the
                last name when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as the
                country code, a space, and the national digits grouped in threes
                (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: The owner's unified member identifier, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'. REGION is the region derived from the owner's
                postcode (falling back to the city, then 'UNKNOWN'); FY is the two-digit
                fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate; HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of the
                SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name; and
                CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW271A2B3C4D5'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by all owners that belong to the
                same household, derived deterministically as the first 12 hex
                characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode
